verdict.rationale: Notion provides infrastructure that supports context-preserving handoff: a REST API to read/write nearly all workspace content, webhooks for real-time event sync, OAuth-based connections, and a documented official MCP server for agent integration, all built around Notion as a 'system of record.' However, there is no first-party or independent evidence of an actual end-to-end handoff scenario (e.g., an agent finishing work in one tool and another agent/tool picking it up in Notion without context loss) being demonstrated or validated. Missing for 10: concrete multi-agent handoff case study, independent/hands-on verification that context/state is preserved across tool transitions, and detail on how conflicts or partial updates are handled during handoff.
